remarks: In-town living at its best. This beautifully updated corner-unit townhouse offers the perfect blend of convenience, ease of living, and refined style in a prime, convenient location in New Canaan. The classic brick exterior sets a timeless tone, while its desirable end-unit positioning provides added privacy and abundant natural light. Inside, thoughtful updates elevate every space. The kitchen features refreshed countertops and a stylish backsplash, seamlessly flowing into a welcoming living area enhanced by custom built-ins. The sunlit primary bedroom is completed with a beautifully renovated en-suite bath. Step outside to your own private garden patio-an ideal retreat for morning coffee or relaxed entertaining. The finished lower level offers a versatile living space: perfect for a family room, playroom, or home office. Whether you're downsizing or searching for a turnkey first home, this exceptional property delivers easy living conveniently near the shops, dining, and everything downtown New Canaan has to offer.
